So: harbour crew owns it, but practically **Ines Fabre** is your contact this week (acting tech lead), and if it's urgent/alerting, whoever's on the PagerDuty rotation.

One relevant side note: there's a known failure mode on record — a deploy of atlas that skips `bin/ship.sh` leaves the search index stale (cost the team an afternoon of downtime before) — worth checking if last night's deploy went through that script.
